sql-set.sql: SELECT RP."PermissionId" AS "PermissionId", RP."Id" AS "RolePermissionId", R."Id" AS "RoleId", P."PermissionValue", P."PermissionDisplayName", P."PermissionSetId", ar."DisplayName" AS "PermissionSetName", P."PermissionType", P."ModuleId", a."DisplayName" AS "ModuleName", P."ApiName", P."ActionPermissionEndPoint", R."RoleName", R."RoleValue", P."IsActive" FROM "RolePermission" AS RP INNER JOIN "Permission" P ON RP."PermissionId" = P."Id" INNER JOIN "Role" AS R ON RP."RoleId" = R."Id" INNER JOIN "AuthReferenceLookup" a ON a."Id" = P."ModuleId" INNER JOIN "AuthReferenceLookup" ar ON ar."Id" = P."PermissionSetId" WHERE RP."RoleId" = @RoleId;

SELECT RP."UiPermissionId" AS "PermissionId", R."Id" AS "RoleId", R."RoleName", R."RoleValue", P."PermissionValue", P."PermissionDisplayName", P."UiPermissionTypeId" AS "PermissionTypeId", a."DisplayName" AS "PermissionTypeName", P."PermissionParentId", UP."PermissionDisplayName" AS "PermissionParentName", P."ModuleId" ,ar."DisplayName" AS "ModuleName" FROM "RoleUiPermission" AS RP INNER JOIN "UiPermission" P ON RP."UiPermissionId" = P."Id" AND P."IsActive" = TRUE INNER JOIN "AuthReferenceLookup" a ON a."Id" = P."UiPermissionTypeId" INNER JOIN "AuthReferenceLookup" ar ON ar."Id" = P."ModuleId" LEFT JOIN "UiPermission" UP ON UP."Id" = P."PermissionParentId" INNER JOIN "Role" AS R ON RP."RoleId" = R."Id" WHERE (@RoleId = '0' OR RP."RoleId" = @RoleId);

SELECT P."Id" as "PermissionId", P."PermissionValue", P."PermissionDisplayName", P."PermissionSetId", ar."DisplayName" AS "PermissionSetName", P."PermissionType", P."ModuleId", a."DisplayName" AS "ModuleName", P."ApiName", P."IsActive" FROM "Permission" AS P INNER JOIN "AuthReferenceLookup" a ON a."Id" = P."ModuleId" INNER JOIN "AuthReferenceLookup" ar ON ar."Id" = P."PermissionSetId" WHERE P."IsActive" = true AND P."IsDeleted" = false ORDER BY P."PermissionDisplayName" DESC;

SELECT P."Id" as "PermissionId", P."PermissionValue", P."PermissionDisplayName", P."PermissionSetId", ar."DisplayName" AS "PermissionSetName", P."PermissionType", P."ModuleId", a."DisplayName" AS "ModuleName", P."ApiName", P."IsActive" FROM "Permission" AS P INNER JOIN "AuthReferenceLookup" a ON a."Id" = P."ModuleId" INNER JOIN "AuthReferenceLookup" ar ON ar."Id" = P."PermissionSetId" ORDER BY P."PermissionDisplayName" DESC;

UPDATE "Permission" SET "PermissionValue" = @PermissionValue, "PermissionDisplayName" = @PermissionDisplayName, "PermissionSetId" = @PermissionSetId, "PermissionType" = @PermissionType, "ModuleId" = @ModuleId, "IsActive" = @IsActive, "IsDeleted" = @IsDeleted, "IsApproved" = @IsApproved, "ApproverId" = @ApproverId, "ApprovedDateTime" = @ApprovedDateTime, "IsAuthorized" = @IsAuthorized, "AuthorizedById" = @AuthorizedById, "AuthorizedDateTime" = @AuthorizedDateTime, "UpdatedDateTime" = NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', "UpdatedBy" = @UpdatedBy WHERE "Id" = @Id;

SELECT R."Id", R."RoleName", R."RoleValue" FROM "Role" AS R WHERE (R."IsDeleted" IS NULL OR R."IsDeleted" = FALSE) AND ((@RoleId IS NULL OR @RoleId = '0') OR R."Id" = @RoleId);
--permission SELECT RP."PermissionId" AS "PermissionId", P."PermissionDisplayName", P."PermissionValue", P."PermissionSetId", ar."DisplayName" AS "PermissionSetName", RP."RoleId" as "Id", P."PermissionType", P."ModuleId", a."DisplayName" AS "ModuleName", P."IsActive" FROM "RolePermission" AS RP JOIN "Permission" P ON P."Id" = RP."PermissionId" AND (P."IsDeleted" IS NULL OR P."IsDeleted" = FALSE) INNER JOIN "AuthReferenceLookup" a ON a."Id" = P."ModuleId" INNER JOIN "AuthReferenceLookup" ar ON ar."Id" = P."PermissionSetId" WHERE (RP."IsDeleted" IS NULL OR RP."IsDeleted" = FALSE) AND ((@RoleId IS NULL OR @RoleId = '0') OR RP."RoleId" = @RoleId);
UPDATE "UiPermission" SET "IsActive" = @IsActive, "PermissionDisplayName" = @PermissionDisplayName, "UpdatedDateTime" = @UpdatedDateTime, "UpdatedBy" = @UpdatedBy WHERE "Id" = @PermissionId;

SELECT P."Id" as "PermissionId", P."PermissionValue", P."PermissionDisplayName", P."UiPermissionTypeId" AS "PermissionTypeId", a."DisplayName" AS "PermissionTypeName", P."ModuleId", ar."DisplayName" AS "ModuleName", P."PermissionParentId", ui."PermissionDisplayName" AS "PermissionParentName", P."IsActive" FROM "UiPermission" AS P INNER JOIN "AuthReferenceLookup" a ON a."Id" = P."UiPermissionTypeId" INNER JOIN "AuthReferenceLookup" ar ON ar."Id" = P."ModuleId" LEFT JOIN "UiPermission" AS ui ON ui."Id" = P."PermissionParentId" ORDER BY P."PermissionDisplayName" DESC;
DELETE FROM "UserRole" WHERE "UserId" = @UserId AND "RoleId" = @RoleId;
UPDATE [UserPasswordHash] SET [PasswordHash] = @PasswordHash, [UpdatedBy] = @UpdatedBy, [UpdatedDateTime] = @UpdatedDateTime, [UpdateReason] = @UpdateReason WHERE [UserId] = @UserId;
SELECT [UserId], [PasswordHash], [UpdatedBy], [UpdatedDateTime], [UpdateReason] FROM [UserPasswordHash] WHERE [UserId] = @UserId;
UPDATE "User" SET "AccessLevel" = @AccessLevel, "UpdatedBy" = @UpdatedBy WHERE "Id" = @UserId;
SELECT "AccessLevel" as "UserAccessLevelName", "DisplayName" as "UserAccessLevelValue" FROM "UserAccessLevel";

UPDATE "User" SET "EmpId" = @EmpId, "EmpType" = @EmpType, "FirstName" = @FirstName, "LastName" = @LastName, "SecondaryEmail" = @SecondaryEmail, "PhoneNumber" = @PhoneNumber, "Extension" = @Extension, "mobile" = @mobile, preferred_username = @preferred_username, display_name = @display_name, given_name = @given_name, family_name = @family_name, "Position" = @Position, "BusinessUnit" = @BusinessUnit, "ManagerId" = @ManagerId, "AccessLevel" = @AccessLevel, "Designation" = @Designation, "Department" = @Department, "Location" = @Location, "Organization" = @Organization, "IsActive" = @IsActive, "UpdatedBy" = @UpdatedBy, "UpdatedDateTime" = @UpdatedDateTime WHERE "Id" = @UserId;

UPDATE "UserProfile" SET "DateOfJoining" = @DateOfJoining, "PrimarySkills" = @PrimarySkills, "SecondarySkills" = @SecondarySkills, "TertiarySkills" = @TertiarySkills, "OtherSkills" = @OtherSkills, "UpdatedBy" = @UpdatedBy, "UpdatedDateTime" = @UpdatedDateTime WHERE "UserId" = @UserId;
SELECT R."Id", R."RoleName", R."RoleValue" FROM "Role" AS R WHERE (R."IsDeleted" IS NULL OR R."IsDeleted" = FALSE) AND ((@RoleId IS NULL OR @RoleId = '0') OR R."Id" = @RoleId);

SELECT "UserId", -- "UserPic", -- Uncomment if this column exists and is needed "DOB", "Gender", "BloodGroup", "PersonalEmail", "DateOfJoining", "PassportNumber", "FatherName", "MotherName", "MaritalStatus", "WeddingAnniversaryDate", "SpouseName", "SpouseDOB", "HomeAddress1", "HomeAddress2", "City", "State", "HomeAddressCity", "HomeAddressState", "HomeAddressCountry", "HomePhoneNumber", "EmergencyContactNumber", "EmergencyContactName", "PrimarySkills", "SecondarySkills", "TertiarySkills", "OtherSkills", "Branch", "LookUpCode", "LinkedInUrl", u."display_name" FROM "User" u INNER JOIN "UserProfile" up ON up."UserId" = u."Id" WHERE up."UserId" = @UserId;

SELECT "Id", "UserId", "LastLoginDateTime", "LastLogoutDateTime", "LastActivityDateTime", "LastActivityModule", "LastActionType", "LastActivityDetail", "CreatedBy", "CreatedDateTime", "UpdatedBy", "UpdatedDateTime", "UpdateReason", "OwnerId", "IsActive", "IsDeleted", "IsApproved", "ApproverId", "ApprovedDateTime", "IsAuthorized", "AuthorizedById", "AuthorizedDateTime", "TenantId", "SubTenantId", "SysData", "CustomFields" FROM "UserActivity" WHERE (@UserId IS NULL OR "UserId" = @UserId) ORDER BY "LastActivityDateTime" DESC OFFSET (@PageNumber - 1) * @PageSize ROWS FETCH NEXT @PageSize ROWS ONLY
DELETE FROM RoleUiPermission WHERE RoleId = @RoleId;

-- User Details SELECT u."Id" AS "UserId", u."Email", u."IsActive", u."display_name" FROM "User" u WHERE u."IsDeleted" IS NULL OR u."IsDeleted" = false;
-- User Role Details SELECT ur."Id" AS "UserRoleId", r."RoleName", u."UserName", u."Id" AS "UserId" FROM "UserRole" ur JOIN "Role" r ON (r."IsDeleted" IS NULL OR r."IsDeleted" = false) AND ur."RoleId" = r."Id" JOIN "User" u ON (u."IsDeleted" IS NULL OR u."IsDeleted" = false) AND ur."UserId" = u."Id" WHERE ur."IsDeleted" IS NULL OR ur."IsDeleted" = false ORDER BY r."RoleName" ASC;
SELECT T."Id", T."TeamName", T."TeamShortName", T."Description", T."TeamOwnerId", T."TeamCaptainId" FROM "Team" AS T WHERE T."IsDeleted" IS NULL OR T."IsDeleted" = FALSE;

SELECT T."Id", T."TeamName", T."TeamShortName", T."Description", T."TeamOwnerId", T."TeamCaptainId" FROM "Team" AS T WHERE (T."IsDeleted" IS NULL OR T."IsDeleted" = FALSE) AND T."Id" = @TeamId::UUID;
SELECT UT."MemberId" FROM "TeamMember" AS UT WHERE (UT."IsDeleted" IS NULL OR UT."IsDeleted" = FALSE) AND UT."TeamId" = @TeamId::UUID;

SELECT DISTINCT T."Id", T."TeamName", T."TeamShortName", T."Description", T."TeamOwnerId", T."TeamCaptainId" FROM "Team" AS T INNER JOIN "TeamMember" AS UT ON UT."TeamId" = T."Id" WHERE (T."IsDeleted" IS NULL OR T."IsDeleted" = FALSE) AND (UT."IsDeleted" IS NULL OR UT."IsDeleted" = FALSE) AND UT."MemberId" = @UserId::UUID;
DELETE FROM "TeamMember" WHERE "TeamId" = @TeamId::UUID AND "MemberId" = @MemberId::UUID;

SELECT UT."MemberId", U."Email", U."UserName", U."FirstName", U."LastName", U."mobile" AS "Mobile", U."preferred_username", U."Designation", U."Department", U."AccessLevel" FROM "TeamMember" AS UT INNER JOIN "User" AS U ON U."Id" = UT."MemberId" AND (U."IsDeleted" IS NULL OR U."IsDeleted" = FALSE) WHERE (UT."IsDeleted" IS NULL OR UT."IsDeleted" = FALSE) AND UT."TeamId" = @TeamId::UUID;
